reaction: Leaving the centre growing is a practical harvesting detail.
reason: Both components are ready, so combining them should complete the meal.

effect: The lettuce and stew are served together, completing the chapter’s remaining goal.
reaction: The supper is a satisfying payoff for the crops kept alive through the storm.

mostWorthwhile.text: Cooking the soaked beans separately was worthwhile: the pressure-cooking and safe handling details made the meal preparation feel physically grounded.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the pods was less interesting than the harvest and cooking, though it usefully revealed how to shell them.

surprise.text: I expected to put the dry beans straight into the pot; the feedback showed they needed soaking first.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. Using cloth to catch the shelled beans was not obvious beforehand, but its purpose was clear afterward.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the meal paid off earlier survival and growing work, and I would be curious to see what happens to the specimens on the journey home.
